notes: Fixed: a bill saved as Credit (pay later) with an amount typed took that amount out of the cash drawer and could push it below zero. Money is now Cash or Bank everywhere (Bank then asks UPI or transfer), and paying a supplier or taking a payment asks which. A bill says how it was paid: with the bill, from an advance, or later. A bill for a party holding an advance offers Use advance or Pay full now. New: Cash history and Bank history with the balance after every line; a business report (MIS) on Reports; both save as PDF, Excel or CSV. Expenses can be paid from Outside (your own pocket, cash and bank untouched) or part from cash and part from bank. Customers and Suppliers show Collected and Paid so far. The side bar is one short list with Cash & Bank and Add expense. Shop details are filled in on one page, My shop. Fixed: a backup now carries the stock movement history.
